description: Verify every CSDB object (data modules by default; optionally publication modules etc.) found in the given folders, and return one VerificationStatus per object plus totals (valid / XSD errors / BREX violations / unresolved references / unreadable). Use offset/limit to page. Pass reportPath to also write the full JSON report to a file.

csdbDirs.description: Folders to verify (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). Referenced objects are also searched here. When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

include.description: Object kinds to verify (default: dm and pm).

reportPath.description: If given, the full report (all details) is written to this JSON file; the response keeps only the statuses.

skip.description: Steps to skip. Skipped steps are reported with state "not-run".

name: verify_csdb
